Container.Name: Site-Gateway
Container.Overview:
Site Gateway is a self-hosted reverse proxy and site-management app built on top of Caddy. It gives you a web UI for the routing patterns most people actually need — hosted sites, proxy hosts, redirects, and streaming hosts — with automatic HTTPS certificate management, live DNS/port/TLS/upstream health checks, and detailed access and gateway-event logs. Advanced users can still drop in custom Caddy directives per route when they need something the UI doesn't cover.
Data lives locally in SQLite inside your appdata folder — no external database to run. Three built-in roles (Administrator, Standard, Viewer) let you share access with a team without giving everyone full control.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Where Site Gateway stores its SQLite database, hosted files, backups, and certificates (including private keys). This is real, durable data, not a cache — point it at a protected array or pool location rather than an unprotected cache-only share.

Config.Name: ADMIN_USERNAME
Config.Description: Login name for the first-run admin account. Pre-filled with admin — used the first time you log in to the dashboard; you can create additional users afterward.

Config.Name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Password for the first-run admin account, used the first time you log in to the dashboard. Pre-filled with changeme as a placeholder — required, and you must replace it with a real password before starting the container.

Config.Name: SESSION_SECRET
Config.Description: Required. A random secret (at least 32 characters recommended) used to sign login sessions — it is not a password and is never used to log in. Changing it later signs every logged-in user out.

Config.Name: BACKUP_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Encryption password used only when encrypted scheduled backups are enabled. Leave blank to disable backup encryption.

Config.Name: ACME_EMAIL
Config.Description: Optional, but recommended. Let's Encrypt uses this address to warn you if a certificate renewal is failing — without it you won't be notified until a site actually goes down.

Config.Name: ADMIN_PORT
Config.Description: Internal port the admin dashboard listens on. Must match the WebUI port mapping's target below if changed.

Config.Name: SITE_PORT_MIN
Config.Description: Start of the port range Hosted Sites use internally, and are reachable on directly (host-ip:port) for LAN-only access, in addition to through Caddy on 80/443. Must not overlap ADMIN_PORT, 80, 443, or any port you use for Streaming Hosts — the app reserves this whole range and will refuse to reuse a port already claimed elsewhere.

Config.Name: SITE_PORT_MAX
Config.Description: End of the port range Hosted Sites use internally, and are reachable on directly (host-ip:port) for LAN-only access, in addition to through Caddy on 80/443. Must not overlap ADMIN_PORT, 80, 443, or any port you use for Streaming Hosts — the app reserves this whole range and will refuse to reuse a port already claimed elsewhere.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the container writes /data as. Unraid convention is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the container writes /data as. Unraid convention is 100 (users).

Config.Name: DATA_DIR_LIMIT_GB
Config.Description: Optional, display-only. Tells the Dashboard/Administration > System resource panel how much space is actually assigned to this app's data (useful if your appdata share doesn't use the whole array/pool), so the Disk percentage shown is meaningful instead of comparing against total array capacity. Leave blank if you don't need that panel to be precise.

Config.Name: HTTP
Config.Description: Plain HTTP — required for HTTP-01 ACME challenges and HTTP→HTTPS redirects.

Config.Name: HTTPS
Config.Description: HTTPS for every hosted site and proxy host.

Config.Name: Hosted Sites range
Config.Description: Publishes the Hosted Sites port range (see SITE_PORT_MIN/SITE_PORT_MAX above) so hosted sites are reachable directly at host-ip:port on your LAN, in addition to through Caddy on 80/443.

Config.Name: Streaming Host Port Forward (example)
Config.Description: Not required — shown only as an example. Add one line like this per Streaming Host you configure in the dashboard, matching whatever port you enter there (e.g. a game server on 25565). Must be a port outside the Hosted Sites range above and not 80/443/ADMIN_PORT. Delete this example if you're not using Streaming Hosts.

Config.Name: Docker Socket (optional)
Config.Description: Must be mounted to enable 'Pick from running containers' when configuring Proxy or Streaming host targets — without it, that feature stays unavailable and you'll enter targets by IP/hostname manually instead. Access to the Docker socket is effectively root on the host, so only mount it if you want this feature.
